_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Hao, Y.[Yabo], Zhang, S.[Songhong], Yao, K.[Kejian], Vapor Liquid Equilibrium Data for Methanol + tert-Butylamine + N,N-Dimethylformamide and Constituent Binary Systems at Atmospheric Pressure, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 1244-1248
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4, 5. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0049. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
